scope: Each Mech's live GitHub Pages site on 2026-10-05, not the repository pins used by the census. Every verdict was tested in headless Chrome by one agent (real identifier and label searches, filters, URL state, theme persistence across pages, 390 px overflow, data requests aborted on purpose), re-tested independently by a skeptic, settled by an arbiter where the two disagreed, and compared column by column across all twelve sites against written calibration rules. deployed_revision is the github-pages deployment the final check saw; TraitMech and CellStructureMech redeployed several times that day.

search.label: Search
search.definition: A labeled text search whose scope is the whole published corpus, tested with a known identifier and a known label.

facets.label: Filters
facets.definition: Filter controls on record properties, with a way to clear them.

result_counts.label: Result counts
result_counts.definition: A count of matching records that updates with search and filters, distinct from the total.

sorting.label: Sorting
sorting.definition: The reader can change the sort order of a listing.

shareable_state.label: Linkable search
shareable_state.definition: Search and filter state is kept in the URL, so a filtered view can be bookmarked and restores on load.

full_catalogue.label: Complete catalog
full_catalogue.definition: Every record the site counts is reachable from it, by listing, pagination, shards or lazy loading.

record_pages.label: Record pages
record_pages.definition: Each record has its own stable, linkable URL.

term_links.label: Labeled terms
term_links.definition: Ontology terms show a readable label beside the CURIE, and the CURIE links to a resolver.

evidence.label: Evidence links
evidence.definition: References (PMID, DOI or URL) are shown on record pages and linked.

review_status.label: Curation status
review_status.definition: Each record shows its curation or review status.

curation_history.label: Curation history
curation_history.definition: The record view shows its curation events: what changed, when and by whom.

source_link.label: Source link
source_link.definition: The record view links to the record's source file in the GitHub repository.

domain_view.label: Domain visual
domain_view.definition: A view suited to the domain, such as a structure depiction, pathway diagram, network, lineage or map.

cross_mech_links.label: Cross-Mech links
cross_mech_links.definition: Record views link to specific records in sibling Mechs or in kg-microbe.

corpus_stats.label: Corpus statistics
corpus_stats.definition: The landing page shows generated corpus counts.

category_browse.label: Category browsing
category_browse.definition: Category or class pages lead into subsets of the corpus.

suite_nav.label: Suite link
suite_nav.definition: A visible link to the X-Mech Suite directory at culturebotai.github.io/mechs/.

downloads.label: Downloads
downloads.definition: A bulk machine-readable export (JSON, TSV, YAML, KGX or SSSOM) is linked from the site.

schema_docs.label: Schema docs
schema_docs.definition: LinkML schema documentation is published on or linked from the site.

license.label: License
license.definition: The site states the data or code license.

build_provenance.label: Build date
build_provenance.definition: The site states when it was built or which revision or data version it shows.

theme_toggle.label: Theme toggle
theme_toggle.definition: A light and dark toggle whose choice carries across pages.

responsive.label: Narrow screens
responsive.definition: No horizontal page overflow at 390 pixels on the landing, browse and record pages; wide tables scroll in their own region.

load_failure.label: Load errors
load_failure.definition: When a data index fails to load, the page shows an error rather than an empty result.
